They are in a room with a plain, light-colored textured wall and a small light fixture. (2) The man begins to strum the guitar, and the girl looks directly into the camera as she starts to sing. White lyric subtitles appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (3) The man joins in the singing while continuing his rhythmic guitar playing. They both appear focused on the performance. The camera remains stationary in a medium-full shot capturing their upper bodies. (4) The musical performance continues with both individuals alternating lead vocals and harmonizing. Their facial expressions convey the emotional weight of the song's lyrics. (5) The video concludes as they finish the song, maintaining their positions in the static frame throughout the entire duration.
